notes.title: Achivements and Magic!
notes.content:
Achievements have finally been added, sorry it took a while. I added achievements in Woodcutting, Mining, Smithing, Firemaking and Fishing with more coming soon. I also added a new combat style and made it easier to see the stats and drops of opponents. 

New:
- 54 Achievements in different areas
- Added drop tables to mobs
- Added combat stat info
- Added new enemies to combat
- Added new combat method magic
- Minor bug fix to solver buttons out of screen

To start training magic you must first defeat a magic goblin to get a simple wand. By equipping this wand you get access to twelve different spells that grants magic xp on cast.

notes.title: Runecrafting!
notes.content:
Runecrafting is finaly here. Sorry for a late update, but now it is here.

New:
- Added skill runecrafting
- Added new "ore" in mining, used in runecrafting
- Added bank button to some scenes to see resources better
- Added a bank to see all resources
- Added placeholder achievements (can not get them yet)
- Minor bug fixes

Again sorry for a late update, but i have started working on the next one, Magic!
